title: From Semantic to Token Communication: The Next Paradigm for Large-Model-Driven 6G Intelligent Connectivity
abstract: arXiv:2609.10714v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The ambitious requirements of sixth-generation (6G) networks are driving communication systems from reliable bit delivery toward meaning-aware and task-oriented connectivity. Large models (LMs), with strong multimodal understanding and generation capabilities, have accelerated this shift and made semantic communication (SemCom) increasingly practical. Yet current LM-driven SemCom remains fragmented: semantic representations are typically tied to specific modalities, models, or tasks. While the bit provides a universal unit for digital transport, there is still no analogous unit for representing and processing semantics, which limits interoperability, theoretical unification, and scalable system design. We argue that tokens provide a natural candidate for this missing abstraction. translated_title: 从语义通信到令牌通信：大模型驱动的6G智能连接新范式
translated_abstract: 第六代（6G）网络的宏大需求正推动通信系统从可靠的比特传输向语义感知、面向任务的连接转变。大模型（LM）凭借其强大的多模态理解与生成能力，加速了这一转变，使语义通信（SemCom）日益走向实用化。然而，当前大模型驱动的语义通信仍然碎片化：语义表示通常绑定于特定的模态、模型或任务。虽然比特为数字传输提供了通用单元，但目前仍缺乏一个用于表示和处理语义的类似单元，这限制了互操作性、理论统一性以及可扩展的系统设计。我们认为，令牌为这一缺失的抽象提供了天然的候选。两大趋势支持这一观点：统一的多模态大模型现已能够在同一令牌空间中编码文本、图像、音频、视频和机器人动作；同时，分布式大模型推理……
tldr: 本文提出以“令牌”作为语义表示与处理的通用单元，推动通信范式从语义通信迈向令牌通信，以解决当前大模型驱动的语义通信中语义表示碎片化、缺乏统一抽象的问题，为大模型驱动的6G智能连接提供新范式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes tokens as a universal unit for semantic representation and processing, introducing token communication as the next paradigm for large-model-driven 6G intelligent connectivity to overcome the fragmentation of current semantic communication systems.
